status: Recorded before any CN01 data exist: no CN01 job had been submitted.
scope: Analysis only. The QPY, PUB schedule, coupler cohort, blocks and shots are unchanged; the prereg lock file is byte-identical.
split_rule: sorted(numpy.random.default_rng(int(sha256(f'CN01-A3:split:{qpy_sha256}')[:16], 16)).permutation(10)[:4]); replaces the lock's roles (the 4 lowest-CZ-error couplers as training)

models.selection_rule: GLS-BIC (locked covariance construction). The minimum-BIC model is selected if it is local; a non-local model is selected only if its BIC is at least 8 below the best local model's; otherwise the best local model is selected.

held_out.calibration_rule: For every model, the held-out coupler's T1 (execution-time calibration), SPAM ceiling (locked formula) and a white floor solved so the model reproduces that coupler's echo_dd32_8us; trained bath parameters are not refitted.
held_out.primary_score: RMSE of the predicted vs observed change in Phi+ fidelity from 0 ns, at the 6 non-zero stagger offsets
held_out.secondary_score: RMSE of absolute Phi+ fidelity at all 7 offsets (the locked score)
held_out.test: Best local model's RMSE minus the candidate's, paired across the 6 held-out couplers: two-sided t, df = 5; passes if the mean is > 0 and p < 0.05. The candidate is the selected model when it is non-local, otherwise H3 (reported only).

decision_rules.correlated_dephasing_supported: H2 or H3 selected AND C_DFS > 0 with Holm p < 0.05 AND the held-out test passes
decision_rules.non_markovian_correlated_memory_supporte: H3 selected AND C_DFS > 0 (Holm) AND C_memory > 0 (Holm) AND the held-out test passes
decision_rules.spectator_zz_supported: H1 selected AND C_spec > 0 (Holm) AND the held-out test passes
decision_rules.candidate_falsified_by_held_out: H1, H2 or H3 selected AND the held-out test fails (the preregistered kill criterion)
decision_rules.local_non_white_dephasing: descriptive: the best local model is not H0 and beats H0 by delta-BIC >= 8

unchanged_from_lock: counts-to-fidelity extraction and readout handling (shared function, verified identical outputs)
GLS covariance construction and the delta-BIC gate of 8
the four mechanistic contrasts and their Holm correction
